title: WHO: AI in healthcare rules
summary: Guidance on large multimodal models (2024). WHO/Europe (Nov 2025): only 4 of 50 countries surveyed have a health-specific AI strategy; urges workforce training on AI basics, ethics, data. EU edition Apr 2026.
fact: A neutral reference for any country without national rules, including Armenia.
caution: Binding? Guidance. Never imply foreign rules bind Armenian or Gulf hospitals.
